text:
Maria (CEO): Quick update — Hosted API v2.1 is GA as of today. This release adds streaming, tool-calling primitives, and two new model variants (redwood-v2-medium, rwx-4k). Rolling out to hosted regions now. Huge thanks to everyone who shipped this! :tada:

DeployBot: deployment finished: hosted-api-v2.1 -> 12 regions. Release notes: https://console.redwood.ai/releases/v2.1

Raj (Eng): Awesome. Any breaking changes to the SDK or client surface?

Emma (Product): No breaking changes. Streaming and tool-calls are opt-in flags. Example quickstart: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-medium","stream":true,"max_tokens":256}'```

SRE-Oncall: Note for oncall — new dashboard created (Hosted API v2.1 / latency & errors) and alert added for tail latency > 250ms and error-rate > 1%. If you see spikes, ping @SRE-Oncall immediately.

Chris (Marketing): Can we coordinate a short social/blog push? Product brief is ready.

Maria (CEO): Yes — marketing go ahead but hold the broad email until we confirm the weekly usage snapshot at 11:30 PT. Also flag: free-tier request quotas are slightly tightened for GA to protect capacity (see Emma's note below).

Emma (Product): Quota change: free-tier throughput limited to 30 rps per org and burstable tokens reduced — this is proactive to avoid noisy tenants affecting latency for paid customers. We published the updated quota table in the docs and added a banner on the console.

Raj (Eng): Heads-up: tool-calling uses the new tool-response JSON schema (tools.name, tools.output, tools.status). Client libs updated in PR #452: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/452 — please upgrade clients if you rely on tool responses.

DeployBot: Canary autoscaling toggles are on for Dedicated customers; automatic fallback to cpu-backed variants enabled for short GPU outages. If you notice anomalous scaling, run `/report` in #eng-platform.

Chris (Marketing): Scheduled: customer blog tomorrow 09:00 PT, social posts at 09:30 PT. I’ll coordinate with solutions to highlight migration tips.

SRE-Oncall: Small ops note — if you run perf tests vs the new models, tag your runs with `v2.1-ga` so we can correlate with infra metrics.

Maria (CEO): Thanks everyone. Quick ask: if your team has a customer potentially impacted by the quota change, DM me and Emma so we can fast-track exceptions. :pray:

Emma (Product): TL;DR — GA release live, opt-in streaming/tool-calls, new models, slight free-tier quota tightening, monitoring/alerts in place, marketing/blog scheduled. Reach out on-thread for rollouts or urgent issues.
